name: Acrobatics
description: Stay on your feet in tricky circumstances — balancing, tumbling, or trying to flip out of a grapple.

name: Animal Handling
description: Calm, control, or read the intentions of an animal; control a mount in difficult situations.

name: Arcana
description: Recall lore about spells, magic items, eldritch symbols, and the planes of existence.

name: Athletics
description: Climbing, jumping, swimming, grappling — physical situations involving raw force.

name: Deception
description: Convincingly hide the truth — verbally or by acting against your true intentions.

name: History
description: Recall lore about historical events, legendary people, ancient kingdoms, and past disputes.

name: Insight
description: Determine the true intentions of a creature — spot lies, anticipate moves, read body language.

name: Intimidation
description: Influence someone through overt threats, hostile actions, or physical violence.

name: Investigation
description: Look for clues and make deductions; deduce a hidden object's location, infer a missing detail.

name: Medicine
description: Stabilize the dying, diagnose illness, treat wounds with healer's kits.

name: Nature
description: Recall lore about terrain, plants and animals, the weather, and natural cycles.

name: Perception
description: Spot, hear, or otherwise detect the presence of something — keen senses applied to surroundings.

name: Performance
description: Delight an audience with music, dance, acting, storytelling, or another form of entertainment.

name: Persuasion
description: Influence someone with tact, social graces, or good nature — diplomacy and earnest argument.

name: Religion
description: Recall lore about deities, rites and prayers, religious hierarchies, holy symbols, and cults.

name: Sleight of Hand
description: Acts of legerdemain or manual trickery — pickpocketing, palming objects, planting items.

name: Stealth
description: Conceal yourself from enemies, slink past guards, slip away unnoticed, sneak up on someone.

name: Survival
description: Follow tracks, hunt wild game, navigate wilderness, identify natural signs and avoid hazards.
